Military Unit: United States. Army. Illinois Infantry Regiment, 17th (1861-1865). Company A

Other.Title: A. Fred Gilbert
Other.Description: Photograph of Union soldier, A. Fred Gilbert, who served in the 17th Illinois Infantry Regiment, Company A. He is pictured here in his army uniform.
Other.Transcript: Front: A. Fred. Gilbert “A“ Co. 17“ Ill. Infty.; Back: Gilbert, A. Fred 17th Ill Inf. Photographed by Thurlow, One door above L. Howell & Co.'s Bank, Main-St., --- Peoria. A good assortment of Plain and Fancy Cases, Gilt, Rosewood and Union Frames, etc., always on hand. Negative preserved, and additional copies of this picture furnished at any time.
